//: CrysViz theme registry. Theming is two axes: a PALETTE (the dropdown) and a MODE (the icon row). The loader (ui/ThemeManager.js) always applies `base` first, then the CSS the selected palette lists for the effective mode (null = base only). `auto` is a mode, not a palette: it follows the OS prefers-color-scheme and resolves through the palette's own `auto` pair, [light-side mode, dark-side mode]. A palette only offers the modes it lists in `modes`; the icon row disables the rest, and selecting a palette that lacks the current mode falls back through its `auto` pair. To add a palette: create themes/<id>/<mode>.css (+ an icons/ folder if you want to override the defaults) and add one entry below.
